title: The Rubber Duck Convoy to Roanoke
summary: On Sunday, February 8, 2015, a CVICU bed opens at Star City General Hospital in Roanoke. After diverting onto winding U.S. Route 11 around an I-81 crash, Jordan meets Chief Cardiothoracic Surgeon Dr. Tariq Hassan, signs his own open-heart CABG surgical consent, and spends the night before surgery anchored by Lauren in the room and the rest of the family over a synchronized movie stream.
